WITH next_job AS (
    SELECT j.id

    FROM automation_jobs j

    JOIN campaigns c
        ON c.id = j.campaign_id

    JOIN approvals a
        ON a.id = j.approval_id

    WHERE j.job_type = 'create_production_tasks'

      AND j.status = 'queued'

      AND j.available_at <= NOW()

      AND j.attempts < j.max_attempts

      AND c.status = 'approved'

      AND a.decision = 'approved'

    ORDER BY
        j.available_at ASC,
        j.created_at ASC

    FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

claimed_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'processing',
        attempts = j.attempts + 1,
        locked_at = NOW(),
        completed_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM next_job n

    WHERE j.id = n.id

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.job_type,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.payload,
        j.attempts,
        j.max_attempts,
        j.locked_at
)

SELECT
    claimed_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    claimed_job.job_type,
    claimed_job.status AS job_status,
    claimed_job.attempts,
    claimed_job.max_attempts,
    claimed_job.locked_at,

    c.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    c.campaign_code,
    c.product_service,
    c.target_audience,
    c.offer,
    c.objective,
    c.brand_tone,
    c.brief,
    c.status AS campaign_status,

    cv.id::TEXT AS campaign_version_id,
    cv.version_number AS approved_version_number,
    cv.content AS approved_content,
    cv.model_name,
    cv.prompt_version,

    a.id::TEXT AS approval_id,
    a.reviewer_name,
    a.reviewer_email,
    a.feedback AS approval_feedback,
    a.decided_at,

    cl.id::TEXT AS client_id,
    cl.client_code,
    cl.name AS client_name,
    cl.company_name,
    cl.email AS client_email,
    cl.website

FROM claimed_job

JOIN campaigns c
    ON c.id = claimed_job.campaign_id

JOIN campaign_versions cv
    ON cv.id = claimed_job.campaign_version_id

JOIN approvals a
    ON a.id = claimed_job.approval_id

JOIN clients cl
    ON cl.id = c.client_id;

WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

task_rows AS (
    SELECT
        input_data.data,
        task.value AS task

    FROM input_data

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(
            input_data.data->'tasks'
        ) AS task(value)
),

upsert_tasks AS (
    INSERT INTO production_tasks (
        task_key,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_version_id,
        task_type,
        title,
        description,
        status,
        metadata
    )

    SELECT
        task->>'task_key',
        (data->>'campaign_id')::UUID,
        (data->>'campaign_version_id')::UUID,
        task->>'task_type',
        task->>'title',
        task->>'description',
        'pending',
        COALESCE(
            task->'metadata',
            '{}'::JSONB
        )

    FROM task_rows

    ON CONFLICT (task_key)

    DO UPDATE SET
        campaign_version_id =
            EXCLUDED.campaign_version_id,

        task_type =
            EXCLUDED.task_type,

        title =
            EXCLUDED.title,

        description =
            EXCLUDED.description,

        metadata =
            EXCLUDED.metadata

    RETURNING id
),

update_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns

    SET status = 'in_production'

    WHERE id = (
        SELECT
            (data->>'campaign_id')::UUID
        FROM input_data
    )

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_code,
        status,
        updated_at
),

complete_job AS (
    UPDATE automation_jobs j

    SET
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = NOW(),
        locked_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL

    FROM input_data i

    WHERE j.id =
        (i.data->>'job_id')::UUID

      AND j.status = 'processing'

      AND j.job_type =
          'create_production_tasks'

    RETURNING
        j.id,
        j.campaign_id,
        j.campaign_version_id,
        j.approval_id,
        j.status,
        j.attempts,
        j.completed_at
),

enqueue_followup_jobs AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_jobs (
        job_type,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_version_id,
        approval_id,
        status,
        payload
    )

    SELECT
        job_type,

        (i.data->>'campaign_id')::UUID,

        (
          i.data->>'campaign_version_id'
        )::UUID,

        (i.data->>'approval_id')::UUID,

        'queued',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                i.data->>'campaign_code'
        )

    FROM input_data i

    CROSS JOIN (
        VALUES
            ('sync_github_tasks'),
            ('create_campaign_workspace')
    ) AS followup(job_type)

    ON CONFLICT (
        approval_id,
        job_type
    )
    WHERE approval_id IS NOT NULL

    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING id
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '08 - Production Task Worker',

        complete_job.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'production_tasks_created',

        'Production tasks were created from the approved campaign package.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',
                complete_job.id,

            'campaign_code',
                input_data.data
                    ->>'campaign_code',

            'campaign_version_id',
                complete_job.campaign_version_id,

            'task_count',
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM upsert_tasks
                ),

            'followup_job_count',
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM enqueue_followup_jobs
                )
        )

    FROM complete_job

    CROSS JOIN input_data

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    complete_job.id::TEXT AS job_id,
    complete_job.status AS job_status,
    complete_job.attempts,
    complete_job.completed_at,

    update_campaign.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    update_campaign.campaign_code,
    update_campaign.status AS campaign_status,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM upsert_tasks
    ) AS task_count,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM enqueue_followup_jobs
    ) AS followup_job_count

FROM complete_job

JOIN update_campaign
    ON update_campaign.id =
       complete_job.campaign_id;
